$comment: Code areas: which process a function belongs to. Read by the dev-monitor function explorer
(kf/dev-process-monitor › Player fns), which groups each area visually.
Tag in the code with a line comment holding the area NAME:
- first line of a file: `// @px-area <name>` — the whole file;
- directly above a function or interface: the same comment — that declaration only (overrides the file).
Closures inherit the area of the function they are defined in.
`order` = reading order of the legend (roughly: outside in, then down the pipeline).
Importance — `// @px-importance <name>`, placed and resolved like `@px-area` (no closure inheritance).
Untagged: `@public` / `@public @advanced` (the documented API — docs-check enforces it) read as `major`, everything else as `minor`;
so in practice only `important` is ever written, plus any deliberate override.
